content:
- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.0), model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is negative (≤ -0.1), model tends to underestimate prices; increase forecast slightly.
- Model consistently overreacts to recent spikes (especially in last 3–5 days), leading to overshoot; dampen peak forecasts.
- Forecast mean reversion is weak; model often fails to correct downward trends after 10+ days of decline; add slight downward bias for long-term outlook.
- For 30-day horizon, model underestimates true price in early days (1–5) when sentiment is negative; adjust upward for first 5 days if sentiment < 0.
- Model shows persistent lag in capturing sentiment-driven reversals; add 1–2 day buffer for sentiment shifts to trigger correction.
